about: Typed meals for testing the calorie estimate across cuisines, in English and Bulgarian: kcal ranges for the exact amount said, or for one standard single portion when vague. group: kind of food; basis: how the range was worked out; specific: the user said what they had, so the app should never ask; pieces: countable food with no count given, so the app should ask how many; holdout: kept back from the reviewing AI to check fixes on unseen meals.
